snippet.title: Prettiest Morgue Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Run your own morgue fueled beauty agency that uses corpses as models. Try not to get caught by all the people at the beauty shows!
Download for free on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4624780/Prettiest_Morgue?utm_campaign=pm_yt
